statement: Every node's shared formation-release owner is armed by authoritative priority-placement blocking observed by a priority planning leader even when no ordinary entity evaluates before clear; priority partitions remain undeferred, a late first ordinary evaluation waits the existing post-drain stability contract, and the unchanged MovieLens scenario completes initial schema admission before background placement resumes.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Repair only activation of the existing node-shared formation-release observation. Do not lengthen or replace its stable window, add a second tracker, change the canonical topology-drain classifier, or add a demo-only admission flag.

Priority partitions may observe and arm the shared release owner but must remain undeferred by the ordinary-work fence. Do not broaden the priority partition set, add nodes-p1 to it, change priority move selection, quorum or remove safety, operation budgets, or voter policy.

Do not change the MovieLens workload, 180000ms schema budget, 60000ms schema stability window, two-confirmation rule, 60000ms plus 10000ms ordinary-release contract, polling cadence, retry duration, or concurrency budgets.

Before live validation, reproduce through production planning methods that a priority leader sees blocked placement while no background entity evaluates, then priority placement clears and a late first ordinary evaluation must enter the existing stabilizing state; prove this fails on current source and red on revert.

Only a canonical membership planning snapshot and current priority placement observation may arm the release owner. Missing or malformed publication evidence must not fabricate a blocker, and independent readiness-owner scopes must remain independent.
After deterministic proof, run the unchanged formation probe once and then at most one changed full MovieLens scenario. Preserve stopped-state evidence and do not rerun unchanged bytes after a red.
